environment.description: Deployed as a CLI tool on bare-metal CI runners (Ubuntu 22.04). Config uses key_backend=file with HMAC key stored at /etc/secrets/hmac.key. Tool is invoked by CI jobs to validate deployment tokens. Runners are shared across teams. Attackers with CI job access can invoke the tool repeatedly with crafted tokens and measure timing via time.perf_counter_ns() or external instrumentation. No HSM is configured.

config.access: any CI job can invoke verify-token binary
